power_systems.name: Mana-Based Magic
power_systems.summary: Mana connects to the external natural laws of the world and manifests as spells through constructed magic circles.
mechanics: Mana is stored and refined through a core and internal circuits.
A constructed magic circle connects that mana to a natural law and encodes the spell (element, range, intensity, duration).
Growth comes through meditation, academic study and the progressive construction of new circles.
Higher circles unlock silent casting, direct manipulation of natural laws and the creation of entirely new spells.
Classical specializations include elemental, spirit, healing and illusion magic.

tiers.capabilities: Mana circuit opened. Simple elemental orbs.
First magic circle complete. Basic attack spells; casting speed increases.
Combat and daily magic fundamentals complete. Mana efficiency stabilizes.
Mana attunement complete. Area-of-effect magic possible; efficiency surges.
Fundamental mana understanding. Custom spell variants and personal techniques possible.
Peak mana circulation mastery. Silent casting without visible magic circles.
Grants the title of Archmage. Perfect fusion of mana and mind; can read and predict mana flow. In combat power, an Archmage is equal to a Master-rank swordsman.
Deep insight into the laws of magic. Can manipulate natural laws directly.
Can reinterpret natural laws, rewrite the laws of magic entirely and create completely new magic. Fewer than a handful exist; Ethera is the best-known living example.

limitations_and_balance: Circle count is not a guarantee of victory: knowledge, matchup, preparation and circumstance matter.
Do not assume a character can use every school of magic merely because they have a high circle rank.

power_systems.name: Path of the Sword (Martial Arts / Aura)
power_systems.summary: Mana is absorbed and circulated internally, never cast externally. Swordsmen refine it through inner cultivation and convert it into Aura, which enhances the body, coats weapons and, at Master tiers, manifests as Sword Aura: visible, unique in color for each user, and devastating in power.
mechanics: Ambient mana is absorbed and circulated inside the body; it is never cast externally.
Inner cultivation refines that mana and converts it into Aura.
Aura enhances strength, speed, durability and reflexes, and coats weapons.
At Master tiers, Aura manifests as Sword Aura: visible, unique in color for each user, and devastating in power.
Sustained Aura use strains the body; higher mastery reduces that strain.

tiers.capabilities: Basic mana circulation and body training. Simple body enhancement; strength and speed increase slightly.
Aura flow control achieved. Can focus Aura on specific body parts for temporary power bursts.
Stable full-body Aura circulation. Consistent combat enhancement across all physical abilities.
Simultaneous inner and outer Aura control. Weapon enhancement via Aura coating; sword energy possible. Body strain increases significantly.
Sword energy reshaped and refined through enlightenment. Body strain reduced. A plateau most never surpass.
Aura materializes visibly: Sword Aura forms, with a color unique to its user. Enormous body strain from sustained use. Requires exceptional talent and deep sword enlightenment.
Permanent Sword Aura. Fundamental understanding of Aura as a force of nature. Body and Aura exist in harmony.
Unity of mind, body and will. Will alone shapes Aura, beyond physical limits. Transcendent: fewer than a handful exist in any generation.
Not a separate stage of power but a title: the single strongest Master alive. Only one Master Pinnacle exists at any time.

rules: Only one Master Pinnacle is alive at any given time; the title passes to the strongest when its holder dies or is surpassed.
The current Master Pinnacle is deliberately not fixed. The narrator decides each story: a hidden, unknown master, a known figure, or a vacant title. The topic never has to come up.
A 7-Circle mage (Archmage) is equal in combat power to a Master-rank swordsman.

power_systems.name: Holy Power / Divinity
power_systems.summary: A distinct power system used mainly by the Holy Kingdom of Dominus. It relies on faith, devotion to the Goddess Lily and a divine connection, not on mana circles or the inner refinement of Aura.
mechanics: Drawn from faith, prayer, devotion to Lily and a personal divine connection.
Used for deep healing, barriers and anti-demon arts.
Especially effective against Miasma and demonic entities.
Not ranked by circles; devotion, divine favour and spiritual capacity determine its strength.

terms.saintess: A mortal described as an exceptional conduit of divine power.
terms.holy_knight: A combatant who combines martial training with divine blessing.
terms.inquisitor: A religious investigator or combat specialist associated with Dominus.
terms.holy_maiden: Title reserved for the most powerful combatant of the Holy Kingdom's Theology.

power_systems.name: Miasma
power_systems.summary: The corrupted energy used by the Demon God Cult and the entities of the Abyss Zone.
mechanics: Associated with the Abyss Zone and the Demon God Delphirem.
Highly toxic to ordinary Aura users and mages: it corrupts mana circuits and, with prolonged exposure, body and mind.
Fighting it effectively needs specific countermeasures, most often holy magic (Divinity) or overwhelming pure mana.
Cult members access it through pacts, rituals or offerings.
Sin Bishops receive power comparable to a 7-Circle mage through pacts; Apostles operate at still higher levels.
narrative_constraints: Do not use Miasma as a generic synonym for mana.
Cult activity should usually involve motive, preparation, concealment or consequences rather than random attacks.
A pact should have a meaningful price or risk.

power_systems.name: Spirit Magic
power_systems.summary: A magical tradition of bonding with and summoning spirits. Sia stands out with four elemental spirits.
mechanics: Spirit mages bond with spirits and summon them; the spirits act with their own will.
Spirit names, personalities and contracts are left free to the narrator and may differ in each story.

power_systems.name: Compound-Realm
power_systems.summary: The art of using martial Aura and magic at the same time, at full mastery of both.
mechanics: Requires Master rank in the Path of the Sword and a high circle count in magic.
Emily, the Headmaster, is the only known living person who masters it.
narrative_constraints: No other character uses Compound-Realm unless the current story establishes it.

power_systems.name: Pure Mana
power_systems.summary: Mana condensed to an extreme density without being shaped into a spell or converted into Aura.
mechanics: Overwhelming pure mana is one of the few effective counters to Miasma.
Seriel forms her bow Lactiel and its arrows from condensed pure mana.

cross_system_rule: Mages and swordsmen are fundamentally different in how they channel mana: swordsmen inward (refined into Aura, never cast externally), mages outward (linked to natural laws through magic circles). Divinity and Miasma are separate powers and are never reduced to ordinary mana.
scaling_warning: Rank comparisons are a guide, not a formula. Resolve confrontations with context, skills, preparation, injuries, terrain and stakes, but large rank gaps remain decisive.
